guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 假想檢核 1：裂後承載與纖維橋接；retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60
假想檢核 2：力位移曲線的能量積分；E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J
假想檢核 3：面板厚度與彎曲尺度；M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm
假想檢核 4：纖維方向與法向力分量；Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal
假想檢核 5：拔出功與界面滑移；Wpull=Fmean*slip=80 N*0.010 m=0.80 J per assumed fibre
假想檢核 6：取樣批次與纖維分散；CV=standardDeviation/mean=5 kg/m3/35 kg/m3=0.143=14.3 percent
CEDD 岩洞指南第二版出版於 2018 年，並非本課的實測報告
FHWA 官方典藏將隧道土木手冊出版日期記為 2009 年
factsEn: Assumed check 1: Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging; retention=Fres/Fpeak=18 kN/30 kN=0.60
Assumed check 2: Energy integration of force-displacement curves; E=Fmean*delta=20 kN*25 mm=500 J
Assumed check 3: Panel thickness and bending scale; M=f*b*h^2/6=3 MPa*0.10 m*(0.10 m)^2/6=0.50 kNm
Assumed check 4: Fibre orientation and normal force; Fnormal=100 N*cos(60 deg)=50 N; angle measured from crack normal
Assumed check 5: Pullout work and interface slip; Wpull=Fmean*slip=80 N*0.010 m=0.80 J per assumed fibre
Assumed check 6: Sampling batches and fibre dispersion; CV=standardDeviation/mean=5 kg/m3/35 kg/m3=0.143=14.3 percent
CEDD issued its second cavern guide in 2018; it is not a measurement report for these examples
The FHWA official archive dates the civil tunnel manual to 2009
timeline: 1992　CEDD 出版岩洞工程指南第一版，建立公開技術框架
2009　FHWA 隧道土木手冊彙整多類開挖及襯砌工法
2018　CEDD 第二版岩洞指南更新地層與支護評估脈絡
timelineEn: 1992 — CEDD publishes its first cavern-engineering guide as a public technical framework
2009 — The FHWA civil tunnel manual consolidates excavation and lining methods
2018 — The second CEDD cavern guide updates ground and support assessment
codes: FHWA 道路隧道設計與施工土木技術手冊
CEDD 岩土指南第四冊：岩洞工程第二版
codesEn: FHWA Technical Manual for Design and Construction of Road Tunnels - Civil Elements
CEDD Geoguide 4: Guide to Cavern Engineering second edition
landmarks: 哥達基線隧道（地質邊界比較）
英法海底隧道（地下水邊界比較）
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Fiber-shotcrete toughness testing
guides.concept: 本課以以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土為主線，從裂後承載與纖維橋接與力位移曲線的能量積分建立系統邊界，再把拔出功與界面滑移、荷重位移同步與零點連到性能規格與試法交接。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 十單元以可核算的模型和可追溯證據逐步判讀不同失效。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction. It begins with Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging and Energy integration of force-displacement curves, links Pullout work and interface slip and Force-displacement synchronization and zero, and ends with Performance specifications and method handover. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. Ten units use reproducible models and traceable evidence to distinguish failure mechanisms.
procedure: 首裂以前主要由水泥基材承受拉應力，裂後則由跨縫纖維傳力。纖維可能拔出、拉斷或與基材局部剝離，因此高抗壓不保證高殘餘荷載；應沿整條荷載位移曲線辨識峰值後的衰減，而非只比較最大力。 判別這個機制時，應觀察在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點；若出現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
試板吸收能量是荷載對測定位移的積分，單位為力乘距離。使用橫樑行程會混入機架與接觸變形，積分面積因而可能偏大；位移量測應明確指向試板中央或規定位置，並保存積分區間與離散方法。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積；若出現機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
相同材料配比的面板，厚度改變會改變彎曲剛度、裂縫分布與纖維總數。梁條彎矩尺度對厚度平方敏感，但完整面板仍有雙向裂縫及膜效應；試驗比較必須先鎖定幾何，不可把厚板能量直接當成薄噴層的材料指標。 判別這個機制時，應觀察量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較；若出現厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
纖維沿噴射方向及流動方向重新排列，跨越裂縫的角度影響法向傳力。餘弦可用來投影單根已知纖維的力，卻不能直接計算跨縫根數；根數還受位置、長度及三維取向分布控制，必須透過切面或影像取樣描述。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載；若出現有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
纖維拔出過程的摩擦與機械錨固能持續耗能，過強界面反而可能導致脆性拉斷。拔出功屬單根纖維與試件的組合，不能不考慮互相干擾便乘上所有纖維數；嵌入長度及端部形狀要隨試驗一起報告。 判別這個機制時，應觀察記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例；若出現表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
材料平均纖維質量相同，局部團聚仍會造成弱區。小試樣若只來自易取位置，容易漏掉噴射陰影或回彈較大的區段；抽樣應保留空間位置，將分散度和平均值分開呈現，才能辨識材料混合與施工方向的影響。 判別這個機制時，應觀察以分區洗出或適當材料辨識法比較纖維量離散；若出現團聚區與缺纖區互相平均，留下低韌性的薄弱帶，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
能量積分需要同一時刻的荷重與位移，資料流延遲會把峰值配到錯誤開口。試件接觸前的行程不應列入試板變形，接觸壓密又須與真正裂後位移區分；儀器零點、取樣率及濾波設定都會影響曲線形狀。 判別這個機制時，應觀察用共同事件校核兩通道時間差及接觸零點；若出現時間錯位扭曲裂後面積，造成虛假的韌性增益，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
纖維跨縫數具隨機性，單一試板不能代表整批材料。增加重複數能改善平均值估計，但不能補救有偏的取樣位置；報告應區分樣本標準差與平均值標準誤，並展示個別曲線以辨認異常破壞型態。 判別這個機制時，應觀察比較九片獨立試板的個別曲線、平均值與離散；若出現只報平均值掩蓋少數極低能量試件及取樣偏差，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
裂縫開放後纖維及界面暴露於水與化學環境，長期表現不能只由初期能量推定。加速試驗的溫度或溶液可能改變失效機制，因此老化前後必須採同幾何及同位移定義，並檢查裂縫處的實際腐蝕或脆化證據。 判別這個機制時，應觀察對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀；若出現不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
規格若只寫一個焦耳數卻沒有試板尺寸、支承及截止位移，數字缺乏可比較的物理意義。梁試驗和板試驗有不同裂縫路徑，不能直接換算；交接應保留版本、曲線和取樣方向，讓維修材料採用同一性能語言。 判別這個機制時，應觀察逐項核對試法版本、支承、厚度、取向與截止位移；若出現不同試法結果被拼成一張合格表而無法重算，便須重新檢查原先假設的接觸、力或水的傳遞邊界，而不能只調整計算結果。
procedureEn: The matrix carries most tensile action before cracking; bridging fibres transfer force afterward. Pullout, rupture and local debonding create different responses, so high compression strength does not guarantee residual resistance. Inspect the complete postpeak curve rather than comparing maximum loads alone. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Absorbed panel energy integrates force over the prescribed displacement. Crosshead travel includes machine and contact compliance and can inflate the area. Define displacement at the panel centre or specified location, and preserve the integration interval and discretization method. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement. If frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Thickness changes bending stiffness, crack distribution and the number of engaged fibres even at equal mix. A strip moment scale varies with thickness squared, while full panels add two-way cracking and membrane action. Fix geometry before treating energy as a material comparison. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries. If a thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Spraying and flow orient fibres, and crossing angles affect normal transfer. A cosine projects a known fibre force but does not directly count crossings. Counts also depend on position, length and three-dimensional orientation, requiring section or image sampling rather than a force-projection shortcut. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. If favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Friction and mechanical anchorage dissipate energy during pullout, whereas an overly strong interface can promote rupture. Single-fibre work belongs to that specimen system and cannot be multiplied by every fibre without interaction assumptions. Report embedment length and end shape with the result. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding. If a changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Equal mean fibre mass can coexist with local clusters and weak zones. Convenient small samples can miss spray shadows or high-rebound areas. Retain spatial locations and report dispersion separately from the mean to distinguish mixing effects from placement orientation. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare spatial fibre-content dispersion using washout or suitable material identification. If clusters average with fibre-poor zones and leave a low-toughness band, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Energy integration requires synchronized force and displacement; stream delay pairs a peak with the wrong opening. Precontact motion is not panel deflection, and seating differs from postcrack displacement. Zero, sampling rate and filters therefore influence the interpreted curve. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Check channel lag and contact zero with a shared identifiable event. If timing mismatch distorts postcrack area and creates false toughness improvement, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Random fibre crossings make one panel insufficient for a batch. Replication improves estimation of the mean but cannot correct biased sampling positions. Separate sample standard deviation from standard error and show individual curves so unusual failure patterns remain visible. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare individual curves, mean and dispersion from nine independent panels. If a mean-only report hides very low-energy specimens and sampling bias, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

Open cracks expose fibres and interfaces to water and chemistry, so initial energy cannot establish long-term resistance. Accelerated temperature or solution may change the failure mechanism. Compare identical geometry and displacement definitions and inspect actual corrosion or embrittlement at cracks. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces. If an unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.

A joule requirement without panel size, supports and terminal displacement lacks a comparable physical meaning. Beams and panels form different crack paths and are not directly interchangeable. Preserve method editions, curves and sampling directions so repair materials use the same performance definition. Use the following check to discriminate the mechanism: Audit method edition, support, thickness, orientation and terminal displacement. If different test methods are pooled into a passing table that cannot be reproduced, revisit the assumed contact, force or water-transfer boundary rather than merely adjusting the calculated result.
evidence: 將在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將以校正荷重及獨立中央位移重算梯形積分面積列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現機架柔度被算成試板變形而高估材料吸能，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將以切面纖維取向統計配對裂縫兩側的殘餘荷載列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現有利方向的試體高估另一方向現地裂縫的橋接力，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
將記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例列為該構件的交接證據，連結到施工位置、材料批次及判讀版本。若發現表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變，先保留原始紀錄並由負責技師確認處置，不能以本課算例替代核定作業計畫。
evidenceEn: Apply the following check at handover: Read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Recompute trapezoidal area using calibrated force and independent central displacement. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If frame compliance counted as panel deformation overstates material energy absorption, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Pair sectional orientation statistics with residual loads across the crack. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If favourably oriented specimens overstate bridging across differently oriented field cracks, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.

Apply the following check at handover: Record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding. Link results to location, material batch and interpretation version. If a changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength, retain original records and obtain the responsible engineer's disposition; this example does not replace an approved work plan.
pitfalls: 高峰值後快速失載會被單一最大力報告掩蓋。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到在規定裂縫開口位置讀取殘餘力並標記首裂點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
厚試板掩蓋低纖維效果，現地薄區卻先裂損。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到量測試板各區厚度及支承位置，按相同幾何組別比較，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
表面鍍層變化使滑移功降低，即使鋼絲強度不變。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到記錄拔出曲線、嵌入長度及斷纖或滑移的比例，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
時間錯位扭曲裂後面積，造成虛假的韌性增益。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到用共同事件校核兩通道時間差及接觸零點，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
不相容的加速環境產生錯誤外推，低估現地界面劣化。相似表徵也可能由量測偏差造成，因此應回到對照老化前後同幾何試板及裂面纖維外觀，以獨立證據判別原因；只修補可見症狀將留下原本的傳力或滲流問題。
pitfallsEn: Rapid postpeak loss is concealed by reporting only maximum force. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to read residual forces at specified crack openings and identify first cracking to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

A thick panel conceals weak fibre performance while thin installed zones crack first. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to measure local panel thickness and support positions and compare matched geometries to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

A changed surface coating reduces sliding work despite unchanged wire strength. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to record pullout curves, embedment lengths and proportions of rupture versus sliding to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

Timing mismatch distorts postcrack area and creates false toughness improvement. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to check channel lag and contact zero with a shared identifiable event to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

An unrepresentative accelerated exposure mispredicts field interface degradation. Similar symptoms can arise from measurement bias: return to compare matching panels before and after ageing and inspect fibres on fracture faces to discriminate the cause. Treating visible symptoms alone leaves the original transfer or seepage problem unresolved.

related.title: 隧道岩栓拉拔驗證
related.transfer: 可遷移「裂後承載與纖維橋接」與「荷重位移同步與零點」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道岩栓拉拔驗證的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging" and "Force-displacement synchronization and zero" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土；隧道岩栓拉拔驗證則以辨識岩栓鋼材、漿體與岩體界面的拉拔傳力為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction; Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification centres on distinguish bolt steel, grout and rock interfaces in pullout load transfer, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裂後承載與纖維橋接」與「岩楔荷重與岩栓方向」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道岩栓拉拔驗證，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「持載位移與時間效應」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Postcrack resistance and fibre bridging” and “Wedge weight and bolt direction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Tunnel rock-bolt pullout verification, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Hold movement and time effects", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 纖維噴射混凝土韌性試驗
history.text: 本課討論的以裂後荷載、能量積分與取樣方向驗證纖維噴凝土，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。試板韌性屬特定幾何及邊界，不是整條隧道吸能容量。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。哥達與英法海底隧道僅作地質及地下水邊界的比較，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on verify fibre shotcrete through postcrack load, energy integration and sampling direction reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Panel toughness belongs to a specific geometry and boundary, not whole-tunnel energy capacity. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. Gotthard and the Channel Tunnel are comparisons of geological and groundwater boundaries only. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
